results.title: A review of IoT applications in healthcare
results.content: # A review of IoT applications in healthcare. A systematic theoretical analysis of IoT applications in healthcare is provided. General works on IoT applications in healthcare are well summarized. Future challenges of IoT applications in healthcare are analyzed from several standpoints. Integrating Internet of Things (IoT) technologies in the healthcare industry represents a transformative shift with tangible benefits. This paper provides a detailed examination of IoT adoption in healthcare, focusing on specific sensor types and communication methods. It underscores successful real-world applications, including remote patient monitoring, individualized treatment strategies, and streamlined healthcare delivery. Furthermore, it delves into the intricate challenges to realizing the full potential of IoT in healthcare. This includes addressing data security concerns, ensuring seamless interoperability, and optimizing the use of IoT-generated data. The paper seeks to inspire practitioners and researchers by highlighting the practical implications of IoT in healthcare, emphasizing the ways IoT can enhance patient care, resource allocation, and overall healthcare efficiency.

results.title: The Digital Transformation of Healthcare in 2026
results.content: With DX reshaping patient care, healthcare management, and data processing, healthcare professionals must develop new competencies to operate advanced technologies effectively. Providing corporate training in these areas ensures teams are prepared to handle digital tools and data, improving patient care and operational efficiency. The healthcare industry's digital transformation is essential for improving patient care, enhancing operational efficiency, and ensuring better health outcomes. Healthcare organizations must navigate an increasingly complex regulatory environment as they pursue digital transformation in the healthcare industry, ensuring they comply with laws that govern the use of medical data, digital tools, and patient care. Healthcare professionals, leaders, and teams involved in DX need skills in areas such as corporate data management, EHR systems, telemedicine, AI, cybersecurity, and patient data interpretation. Whether it’s training for healthcare leadership to guide the change process or upskilling employees on AI, data analytics, and digital patient management systems, Edstellar ensures your teams are prepared to manage the digital shift.
